items.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.

items.title: Gaza flotilla activists deported from Israel as backlash over treatment grows
items.description: On Thursday, the UK confirmed it had summoned Israel's top diplomat in Britain to express its "condemnation" of the incident.

items.title: Russia and China condemn US over indictment of former Cuban leader
items.description: It comes after the US charged Raúl Castro with murder, the latest move putting pressure on the regime.

items.title: Air France and Airbus found guilty of manslaughter over 2009 plane crash
items.description: The companies were found guilty by a French court over an air disaster which killed 228 people.

items.title: Charges dismissed against official at school where six-year-old shot teacher
items.description: The child fired a single shot at a teacher, who had to have surgery after the incident in 2023.

items.title: Gonorrhoea and syphilis hit record levels in Europe
items.description: STIs have surged thanks to record cases and gaps in testing and prevention, a health agency reports.

items.title: Dozens of vehicles burnt as Mali jihadists enforce blockade ahead of Eid holiday
items.description: The blockade has led to shortages of fuel and food ahead of next week's Muslim holiday of Eid.

items.title: Walmart warns US shoppers are cutting spending as higher petrol prices bite
items.description: The retail giant said it expects customers to cut back in the coming months due to higher pump prices.

items.title: Nvidia's latest record earnings fail to impress investors
items.description: The chip giant reported more stellar results but its shares fell after-hours as investors wonder if it can keep up its pace of growth amid greater competition.

items.title: DR Congo cancels World Cup training camp over Ebola outbreak
items.description: The outbreak, caused by a rare Ebola species, is thought to have caused 139 deaths so far.

items.title: Ebola vaccine could take nine months as death toll rises further, WHO warns
items.description: In its latest update, the World Health Organization says there have now been 139 suspected deaths and 600 cases.

items.title: Trump says he will speak to Taiwan's president in break from protocol
items.description: It comes as the US weighs whether to proceed with a $14bn arms sales to Taiwan, which China claims as its own.
